notes.title: Demo Update and Demo Details
notes.content:
Demo Update and Details
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44925649/ba0c75c0e703c2e9f6e9012d01895f1e5b0f097e.png[/img]

⭐Fixed map screen switching bug
⭐Added visual improvements in some aspects
⭐Control was disabled as it is not fully programmed
⭐Other minor improvements to the game

[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44925649/fdccd5688cb0048adaaf9dc62f5ea0c3d4ca9175.png[/img]

The demo includes:
🌟 Adventure mode with 4 levels
🌟 Multiplayer
🌟 Player versus player mode
🌟 Endless Mode
🌟 1 Boss
🌟 1 Secret Level by getting all stars
🌟 3 different costumes
🌟 3 different costume effects
🌟 3 different arrow costumes
🌟 2 types of arrows
🌟 4 items in the shop
